audit.whatIsWrong: Dark Procession is labelled as Yorick's E in six places — wants.you[0] 'his E (Dark Procession) cage', wants.foe[0] 'Land E (Dark Procession) cage', early 'his E, Dark Procession', spikes[3] 'E (Dark Procession) cage', whys[3] 'bait the E cage', whys[6] 'his E cage'. Worse, wants.foe[1] ships an editor's note to the reader: 'drop his W (Dark Procession is E; W is Mourning Mist) Mist to slow and zone you' — and that note is itself wrong.
audit.why: Dark Procession is W and Mourning Mist is E, the exact opposite of what the parenthetical says. A player reading this page and then hovering Yorick's abilities in game will find every slot reference reversed, and one line of raw editing scaffolding printed mid-sentence. The two abilities also do completely different things — one is a destructible wall, the other a ranged armour-shredding mark — so the slot confusion is not cosmetic.
audit.corrected: Dark Procession (W) is the destructible wall, 20s at rank 1, 600 range. Mourning Mist (E) is the 700-range mark that shreds armour, slows, and speeds his Mist Walkers toward whatever it hits.
sources: champ-data/_kits/yorick.json (W Dark Procession: 'summons a destructible wall at target location that will block enemy movement', 20/18/16/14/12, range 600, flags terrain; E Mourning Mist: 'reduces armor, damages, slows and marks enemies. Summoned units gain move speed when moving towards marked targets', 12/11/10/9/8, range 700)

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing says the cage is terrain, or that terrain stops Justice Punch.
audit.why: Dark Procession summons a wall that blocks movement, and Galio's charge halts on terrain. So the cage does not merely trap Galio inside it — it also eats the Justice Punch he would use to leave or to reach Yorick, which is the single reason this ability is dangerous to this champion specifically. The wall is destructible, so attacking a segment down is a genuine out that no line on the page mentions.
audit.corrected: The cage is terrain, and Justice Punch halts on terrain — so it blocks the punch as well as your feet. It is destructible: hit one segment down rather than waiting out the 20 seconds.
sources: champ-data/_kits/yorick.json (W: 'destructible wall... will block enemy movement', flags terrain)
wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Galio (Justice Punch: the charge stops on terrain or champions)

audit.whatIsWrong: Mourning Mist's mark is never explained. The page treats it only as 'W-slow'.
audit.why: Mourning Mist marks the target and Yorick's summoned units gain move speed moving toward marked targets. That is how a swarm of Mist Walkers that would otherwise be trivially outrun actually reaches Galio. The rule that falls out of it — break line with the ghouls the moment the mist lands, do not stand and trade through it — is the most useful thing you can tell a Galio in this lane and it is absent.
audit.corrected: Mourning Mist marks you and every Mist Walker speeds toward the mark. Getting hit is not the damage problem, it is the summon problem — move the moment it lands.
sources: champ-data/_kits/yorick.json (E Mourning Mist: 'Summoned units gain move speed when moving towards marked targets')

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0], report[5], tldr and winCon all say 'when Dark Procession is down' and never give the number; whys[3] says 'bait the E cage, then all-in once it is on cooldown' with no duration.
audit.why: Dark Procession is 20/18/16/14/12 — twenty seconds at rank 1, and it is the only thing stopping a Galio all-in on a champion with no dash. Mourning Mist is 12s, Last Rites is 6s and Eulogy of the Isles is 160/130/100, which is why the pre-Maiden window the entry keeps referencing is so long.
audit.corrected: Dark Procession 20s at rank 1 — that downtime is the all-in window. Mourning Mist 12s, Last Rites 6s, Eulogy of the Isles 160s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Galio wins 57.14% of 28 games and the entry says so throughout — 'Levels 4-6 are yours', 'your cleanest kill window all game' — but the chart reads Skill, Yorick, Yorick, Skill, Skill, Yorick, Yorick, four rows to Yorick, and the labels say EVEN, 6/10, yellow.
audit.why: Levels 2 and 3 in particular are the rows the page's own spike text calls Galio's punish window, and the chart hands them to Yorick. Only the last row belongs to Yorick, once Maiden and the ghoul swarm arrive.
audit.corrected: diff FAV, tone #3ddc97, difficulty 4/10, chart Skill, Galio, Galio, Galio, Galio, Galio, Yorick.
sources: scratchpad packet galio.json entry yorick (57.14%, 28 games, no defects)

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[2].why says 'the dash is interruptible and root-able mid-flight', and dontsFull[0] says the cage 'catches you mid-dash'.
audit.why: Yorick has no root and Justice Punch cannot be interrupted once travelling. The cage does not catch you mid-dash either — it is a wall, so the charge simply stops when it hits one, which is a different failure mode with a different answer: break a segment, do not try to time the CC.
audit.corrected: Yorick has no root. Dark Procession is a wall, so the charge stops against it instead of being interrupted — and the wall can be attacked down.
sources: wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Galio (Justice Punch cannot be interrupted mid-travel; charge halts on terrain)

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer never mentions Grievous Wounds and never notes that Last Rites is an auto reset.
audit.why: _missing-interactions.json flags both needs-antiheal (Last Rites) and autoreset-burst-tell (Last Rites) for this pairing, and the kit confirms heal plus autoReset on a 6-second cooldown. So his step-up to melee-CS a ghoul — the exact moment the page tells you to punish — comes with an instant empowered attack and a heal, and the wind-up is the cue rather than the cast.
audit.corrected: Last Rites resets his auto and heals him every 6 seconds, so his CS step-up is two hits and a heal. Grievous Wounds turns that reset into a real cost.
sources: champ-data/_kits/yorick.json (Q Last Rites: 'bonus damage on his next attack and heals himself', 6/5.5/5/4.5/4, flags heal,autoReset)

audit.why: The core plan — punish the melee-CS step-up with Justice Punch into the Shield of Durand taunt, because Yorick owns no dash and cannot leave — is right and is why the win rate is what it is. I kept it and only attached the cooldowns and the correct slot letters.
sources: champ-data/_kits/galio.json (E Justice Punch, W Shield of Durand)

edits.before: Yorick wants to walk up and melee last-hit ghouls while stacking graves for his Maiden — that step-up is exactly what your Level 2-3 E (Justice Punch) knockup punishes, so make him pay every time he reaches for a CS and follow with a Q tornado on top. The one thing to respect is his E, Dark Procession: it summons a ring of spectral mist that cages you in, and if he lands it you cannot walk out while his ghouls and W-slow chunk you, so sidestep it before you commit rather than eating it mid-trade. Trade in short bursts and step out of the ghoul pile.
edits.after: Yorick wants to walk up and melee last-hit ghouls while stacking graves for his Maiden — that step-up is exactly what your Level 2-3 Justice Punch knockup punishes, so make him pay every time and follow with a Q tornado. Watch the wind-up though: Last Rites resets his auto every 6 seconds and heals him. The one thing to respect is Dark Procession, his W: a destructible wall on a 20-second cooldown that blocks movement, and since your charge halts on terrain it stops the punch too. Sidestep it, or break a segment rather than waiting it out.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 are yours. Your Q poke and E-knockup out-trade a Yorick who has no dash to escape, and at 6 Hero's Entrance turns it lethal — flag down on him, R-taunt and knock up, W-release for the second taunt, and his only answer is to die or burn Flash. If he is splitting elsewhere, your R is a free play: roam global and cash in a kill rather than slow-pushing into his wall of ghouls. Just do not chase him into a fresh E cage while his ghouls are stacked.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 are yours. Your Q poke and E-knockup out-trade a Yorick who has no dash to escape, and at 6 Hero's Entrance turns it lethal — flag down on him, R-taunt and knock up, W-release for the second taunt, and his only answer is Flash. notes: wants.foe[1] currently ships an editor's parenthetical to the reader — 'drop his W (Dark Procession is E; W is Mourning Mist) Mist to slow and zone you' — and the note has the slots backwards. Dark Procession is W, Mourning Mist is E. Worth grepping the rest of the dataset for the same parenthetical, since it looks like a note that leaked from a previous editing pass rather than a one-off. Galio facts verified at wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Galio and reused across this slice: Shield of Durand cuts magic 25/30/35/40/45% and physical exactly half (12.5/15/17.5/20/22.5%), passive magic shield 7.5/9/10.5/12/13.5% max health restoring after 12/10/8s untouched, taunt on release. Justice Punch knocks up 0.75s, cannot be interrupted mid-travel, disabled while Grounded, and the charge halts on terrain or champions. Winds of War 825, tornado 2s, no slow. Hero's Entrance channels 2.75s, CC-immune after 1.25s. Colossal Smash is a 5s empowered auto scaling with 60% bonus MR.
